# Source: LangGraph Docs

- Docs source: https://github.com/langchain-ai/docs/tree/main/src/oss/langgraph
- Runtime source: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph
- Docs site: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/overview
- License: MIT, copied in `LICENSE`
- Retrieved: 2026-05-14

## Included Files

- `overview.md`: LangGraph positioning and core orchestration capabilities.
- `graph-api.md`: graph state, nodes, edges, and compiled graph behavior.
- `persistence.md`: checkpointing, threads, graph state snapshots, and memory.
- `interrupts.md`: human-in-the-loop interrupt and resume patterns.
- `durable-execution.md`: durable execution guidance for long-running workflows.
- `fault-tolerance.md`: retry, timeout, and error handling behavior.
- `use-subgraphs.md`: subgraph composition and persistence considerations.
- `thinking-in-langgraph.md`: design guidance for workflow and agent graphs.
- `application-structure.md`: project organization guidance.
- `test.md`: LangGraph testing guidance.

These files are included because Keystone uses LangGraph only as an optional
WorkItem orchestration wrapper around SDK specialists.
